object: Cantor alloy CoCrFeNiMn hydride
problem: Does the Cantor alloy form a high-entropy hydride under high pressure and temperature, and what is its hydrogen content?
mechanism_or_method: High-pressure, high-temperature X-ray and neutron diffraction with ab initio calculations to identify and characterize an fcc hydride.
limitation: Extreme conditions only; hydrogen content only estimated; no mechanical or practical stability assessment.

object: conjugated polymer microdevice integrating energy storage and actuation
problem: How does anion hydration govern the performance-stability trade-off in conjugated polymer storage-actuation devices?
mechanism_or_method: Reducing anion hydration suppresses water ingress, giving single-step volumetric relaxation; used to build a monolithic sub-millimetre battery-actuator device.
limitation: Microscale proof-of-concept; long-term cycling and system integration not established in abstract.
decision_relevance: Guides electrolyte anion choice for microscale integrated actuator-battery designs.

object: dielectric elastomer actuator with phase-transitional ferrofluid electrodes
problem: Can reconfigurable electrodes let dielectric elastomer actuators change operating modes, survive failure, and be recycled?
mechanism_or_method: Solid-liquid switching ferrofluid electrode: sol state magnetically reconfigurable, gel state shape-retaining with reduced interfacial slip.
limitation: Lab-scale demonstrations; lifetime, voltage and scalability not quantified in abstract.

object: flexible metal-organic framework Flex-Cd-MOF-3 for propylene/propane separation
problem: How can cooperative sorbate-sorbent adaptation produce switchable propylene/propane selectivity in a flexible MOF?
mechanism_or_method: Framework expansion/shrinkage coupled with sorbate conformational change reshapes energy landscapes; modeling of the desorption pathway explains binding energies.
limitation: Demonstrated for one framework and one hydrocarbon pair; generality asserted, not shown.

object: isotopically pure graphite thermal transport
problem: Can second sound, wave-like hydrodynamic heat transport, be observed at room temperature in a crystal?
mechanism_or_method: Transient thermal grating spectroscopy on isotopically purified graphite showing damped oscillatory signal and thermal conductivity enhancement beyond diffusive limit.
limitation: Requires isotopically purified samples; only about 10 percent conductivity enhancement over diffusive limit.

object: additively manufactured heat-resistant aluminum alloys
problem: How can AM Al alloys keep strength and creep resistance at 300-400 C despite coarsening and defect mobilization?
mechanism_or_method: Intrinsic attraction strategy: divacancy clusters, solute atmospheres and segregation at precipitates confine vacancies, dislocations and coarsening.
limitation: Lab-scale alloy and a single demonstrator part; long-term service and cost not shown.
decision_relevance: Alloy selection for high-temperature AM bladed components.

object: 3D self-locking granular metamaterial of hooked ellipsoids
problem: Can a granular metamaterial be both ductile, adaptively stiffening and reusable energy-absorbing without confinement?
mechanism_or_method: Rigid ellipsoids with flexible hook appendages interlock; stepwise unhooking, sliding-to-locking transition and interhook friction dissipate energy elastically.
limitation: Small-scale demonstrations; scalability and long-term reuse performance not established in abstract.
decision_relevance: Choice of reusable protective packaging for fragile payloads.

object: covalent organic framework nanosheet gas separation membranes
problem: How to make defect-free, recyclable, pressure-resistant COF membranes for H2/CO2 separation?
mechanism_or_method: TREN molecular knitting of COF nanosheets with solvent-switch-driven disassembly and reassembly, explained by DFT.
limitation: Lab-scale membranes; long-term industrial gas stability and cost not demonstrated.

object: light-driven tumbleweed-inspired rolling robot
problem: Can a spherical robot roll autonomously under constant light without onboard control or power?
mechanism_or_method: Woven photoactive/passive bilayer strips form a hollow sphere that self-rolls under constant illumination.
limitation: Needs sustained illumination; real-world field performance only shown as potential.

object: MOF gel crosslinked mixed matrix membranes for helium recovery
problem: How to overcome discontinuous channels and poor filler-polymer compatibility in He/CH4 separation membranes?
mechanism_or_method: Continuous ZIF-67-NH2 gel crosslinks polyimide via amide bonds and hydrogen bonds, eliminating interfacial voids and creating connected nanochannels.
limitation: Lab-scale membranes tested for 180 h; process energy savings come from simulation.

object: self-healing dielectric elastomer artificial muscle
problem: How to get stable large-strain dielectric elastomer actuation near natural muscle performance with self-healing from damage?
mechanism_or_method: Bimodal network with zwitterionic side groups suppresses electromechanical instability and heals mechanical or electrical damage.
limitation: 150,000-cycle lab tests at high field; long-term durability and efficiency in applications unproven.

object: irradiation-resistant concentrated solid solution alloys
problem: Can tuning local lattice distortion immobilize irradiation-induced defects in structural alloys?
mechanism_or_method: Increase atomic size mismatch, as in Ni80Mo20 with 4.82 percent mismatch, to create an energy landscape that freezes vacancy and interstitial motion.
limitation: Ion irradiation on one binary alloy; neutron irradiation and mechanical properties not shown.
decision_relevance: Alloy design criterion for fission and fusion structural materials.

object: phase-transition eutectogel switchable adhesive with ML sensing
problem: Can adhesion be switched on varied substrates while wirelessly sensing adhesion force in real time?
mechanism_or_method: Electrothermally switchable eutectogel adhesion combined with machine-learning-based wireless adhesion sensing for grippers and climbing robots.
limitation: Lab demonstrations on limited substrates; durability and load capacity not stated.

object: Cf/SiC ceramic-matrix composites with porous interphase
problem: How to raise both strength and toughness of ceramic-matrix composites beyond the classic trade-off?
mechanism_or_method: Nacre-inspired nanoporous pyrolytic carbon interphase lowers debonding strength, deflects cracks and raises interfacial friction for load transfer.
limitation: Single-tow specimens primarily; scale-up and high-temperature oxidizing performance not shown.
decision_relevance: Interphase design choice for strong, tough ceramic composite components.

object: electro-membrane crystallization for lithium-ion battery leachates
problem: How to prevent mineral scaling on membranes while recovering metals from battery leachates?
mechanism_or_method: Electric field-assisted organic acid control drives ligands into the membrane to dissolve hydroxide scale and crystallize metals, supported by DFT.
limitation: Bench-scale on synthetic leachates; long-term operation and real leachate variability untested.

object: Drosophila head-thorax fold epithelial morphogenesis
problem: How do tissue curvature and in-plane tension jointly drive epithelial folding in the Deformed compartment?
mechanism_or_method: Dfd modulates actomyosin tension via Tollo and Dystroglycan; curved geometry converts in-plane tension into inward folding force.
limitation: Single fold in Drosophila; generality to other tissues not tested.

object: photocreased polymer filaments that self-spin into bundles
problem: Can encoded local curvature and twist in filaments program autonomous formation of linked microfiber bundles?
mechanism_or_method: Patterned photocreasing of filament arrays drives programmed 3D geometries and autonomous spinning into entangled bundles.
limitation: Mesoscale lab demonstration; strength and scalability of resulting bundles not quantified.

object: thin film transfer by electro-capillary peeling
problem: How to peel and transfer thin films nondestructively with minimal deformation?
mechanism_or_method: Electric field drives liquid to percolate into the bonding layer; Maxwell stress competes with adhesion and tension stresses.
limitation: Tested on selected films and voltages; large-area and industrial transfer unproven.
decision_relevance: Choice of low-strain film transfer method for microscale devices.

object: crosslinks in elastomeric polymer networks
problem: How non-uniform is the elastic response of individual crosslinks in a polymer network before failure?
mechanism_or_method: Phosphorescent extensophore probes give continuous optical force readout proportional to deformation at the single-crosslink level.
limitation: Requires synthesized probe molecules; calibration and generality across networks not shown.

object: metastable elastocapillary systems with bubbles
problem: Can capillary forces and bubble formation in hydrophobic cavities produce volumetric negative compressibility?
mechanism_or_method: Capillarity precompresses the elastic solid; threshold reversible bubble formation releases precompression so volume expands under compression.
limitation: Demonstrated for limited systems; practical device operating ranges and hysteresis not detailed.

object: epitaxial colloidal crystal dislocation networks
problem: How do dislocation interactions govern plastic relaxation of epitaxial misfit strain in thin films?
mechanism_or_method: Real-time 3D confocal microscopy of colloidal crystals resolving single-particle dislocation formation, attraction, sessile junctions and blocking.
limitation: Colloidal model system; transfer to atomic crystals is argued, not demonstrated.

object: vascular reactivity in pregnant mice
problem: Can photoacoustic tomography noninvasively measure acute systemic and placental vasoactivity in vivo?
mechanism_or_method: Spherical-view photoacoustic tomography tracks artery dilation after two vasodilators, including maternal-fetal vasculature.
limitation: Preclinical mouse study with two vasodilators; human translation untested.

object: MoS2 thin film blisters on substrate in humid environment
problem: Why do MoS2 films form solitary-wave-like blisters that propagate in humid conditions?
mechanism_or_method: Interfacial water nanolayer causes delamination at the blister front and readhesion at the tail; energy-based buckle propagation model predicts morphology.
limitation: Specific to MoS2 films on one substrate under humidity; generality to other films unclear.

object: shallow crust beneath the Los Angeles Basin near active faults
problem: Can ambient noise differential adjoint tomography image fluid-bearing rocks near the Newport-Inglewood Fault?
mechanism_or_method: Differential adjoint tomography cancels noise-source bias in ambient noise data from the LASSIE linear array to image S-wave velocity and porosity.
limitation: Single linear array gives 2D image; porosity relies on previous P-wave studies.
decision_relevance: Groundwater resource and ground-motion hazard assessment near faults.

object: local atomic environments in model glasses
problem: Can a low-dimensional structural manifold parameterize local structure in disordered materials without crystalline bias?
mechanism_or_method: Gaussian Integral Inner Product distance with agglomerative clustering and diffusion maps parametrizes the local structural manifold.
limitation: Applied only to model systems; descriptors need post-hoc interpretation.

object: ultrafast melting and recrystallization of ice
problem: What are the domain sizes and timescales of ice melting and recrystallization after ultrafast heating?
mechanism_or_method: IR laser heating with time-resolved WAXS and SAXS at an x-ray pulse source to extract molten fraction and liquid domain size.
limitation: Requires x-ray free-electron laser facility; single heating condition.

object: soft material spatial structures woven by elastocapillary rolling transfer
problem: How can soft wires, ribbons and films be assembled into 3D spatial structures simply?
mechanism_or_method: Rotating curved substrates relative to soft materials on a liquid surface weaves them with controllable chirality, order and folds.
limitation: Lab-scale manual-style assembly; throughput and precision for devices not quantified.

object: magnetic paramagnetic colloidal bipeds
problem: Can a fixed magnetic control loop make growing colloidal rods stop at a set length by walking away?
mechanism_or_method: Metamorphic hexagonal magnetic pattern and cyclic field loops make colloids walk, assemble, and switch behavior topologically at outgrown length.
limitation: Microscale lab setup with patterned magnetic substrate; scaling to larger systems unaddressed.

object: swarms of self-propelled robots transporting a passive payload
problem: How can robots without sensing or communication cooperatively transport a payload directionally?
mechanism_or_method: Friction and mass distribution give agents a negative active charge-like force-alignment parameter, yielding a bifurcation criterion for transport.
limitation: Tabletop robots with circular payloads; real-world terrain and non-circular loads untested.
decision_relevance: Mechanical design rules for sensorless swarm robots carrying loads.

object: US wholesale electricity markets and interregional transmission
problem: What is the market value of added transmission capacity and what drives it across US regions?
mechanism_or_method: Retrospective analysis of 2012-2022 wholesale energy prices to estimate value per GW and compare with annualized cost estimates.
limitation: Historical prices ignore market response to added capacity and future system changes.
decision_relevance: Prioritizing interregional transmission investment, especially across regional seams.

object: chiral magnetically orientable nanorod assemblies
problem: Can self-regulating assembly size and shape be tuned reversibly by an external stimulus?
mechanism_or_method: Magnetic field balances chirality-induced twisting with magnet-induced flattening, changing effective chirality and thus assembly size and shape.
limitation: Specific nanorod system requiring synthesis and magnetic setup; generality unclear.

object: Ni4O4-cubane squarate coordination framework
problem: Can one porous framework combine sieving and host-guest recognition for several separations?
mechanism_or_method: Designed porous Ni4O4-cubane squarate polymer tested for hexane isomer, Xe/Kr and CO2/N2 separations.
limitation: Proof-of-concept separations; industrial performance under real mixtures not shown.

object: liquid-infused porous piezoelectric scaffold under cyclic loading
problem: Can a material strengthen and increase energy dissipation under cyclic loading instead of degrading?
mechanism_or_method: Self-recoverable mineralization under mechanical loading, seen by CT, raises modulus and hysteresis after millions of cycles.
limitation: Lab specimens; environmental stability and larger-scale structural use not shown.
decision_relevance: Material choice for fatigue-resilient, load-adaptive structures.

object: catalyzed MEA solvent regeneration in CO2 capture
problem: Does catalyzing amine solvent desorption at lower temperature actually reduce energy use given thermodynamic limits?
mechanism_or_method: Thermodynamic argument that desorbed CO2 quantity at lower temperature is equilibrium-limited regardless of catalyst kinetics.
limitation: Short comment; no new quantitative data and limited to conventional MEA solvent.
decision_relevance: Questions whether catalysts benefit conventional amine capture plants.

object: hybrid hydrogel xerogel fibers with cellulose nanocrystals
problem: What controls the transition from homogeneous to heterogeneous core-sheath structure during drying?
mechanism_or_method: Deborah number set by relative evaporation speed, with transition near De of 1, resembling humidity-dependent glass transition.
limitation: Single hydrogel-CNC system; link to natural heterogeneous structures is by analogy.

object: muscovite mica nanoindentation displacement bursts
problem: How does chemically reactive environment weaken mica, as quantified by burst statistics?
mechanism_or_method: Apply an earthquake-type statistical slip-avalanche model with a mechanical weakening parameter to nanoindentation burst statistics.
limitation: One mineral and indentation geometry; universality claim is suggested, not tested.

object: molten salt electrorefining of titanium
problem: How to remove nonuniform geometric effects of electrodes for long-term stable high-purity titanium refining?
mechanism_or_method: In situ high-temperature characterization yields an anodic dissolution principle; coaxial anode-cathode configuration equalizes overpotential distribution.
limitation: About 12 hours operation at lab scale; industrial scale-up not shown.

object: Paratrechina longicornis ant collective food transport
problem: Is the collective response of ants to a leader force maximal at a critical group size?
mechanism_or_method: A robotic system mimics a transient leader applying ant-scale forces; response measured in sub, near and supercritical group sizes with theory and simulation.
limitation: Single ant species and task; criticality inferred from group-size scan.

object: silicon nano-kirigami structures
problem: How do plastic, elastic and hysteretic deformations arise and can they be controlled in silicon nano-kirigami?
mechanism_or_method: Ion-irradiation stress gradients explained by a torque model; electrical or mechanical stimuli drive elastic modes; capacitor-like charge accumulation explains hysteresis.
limitation: Focused ion beam fabrication is serial and low throughput.

object: self-reconfigurable modular robots with user guidance
problem: How can users safely control modular robots whose shape and size change?
mechanism_or_method: Online optimization filters user commands against constraints, with Joint-space Joysticks matching robot morphology; tested on Mori3 and Roombots.
limitation: Two lab robot platforms; no study of larger collectives or user variability reported.

object: experimental laboratory faults with slow slip
problem: How do evolving fault fabrics and heterogeneity control nucleation, propagation and arrest of slow slip instabilities?
mechanism_or_method: Transparent shear setup with video tracking of fabric evolution and stress redistribution during unstable slip.
limitation: Analogue material in a small apparatus; scaling to natural faults questioned.

object: slender magnetic soft structures with anisotropic flexural joints
problem: How to keep magnetic soft devices stable under misaligned and fluctuating magnetic fields?
mechanism_or_method: Flexural-joint design gives about 52-fold higher bending and 18-fold higher torsional stiffness; used for tentacles, guidewires and capsules.
limitation: Benchtop phantom-level tests; in vivo performance and imaging integration not shown.
decision_relevance: Structural design for magnetically steered medical guidewires and soft devices.

object: heterogeneous-structure facial mask for cold environments
problem: How to keep face and inhaled air warm and humid in extreme cold while allowing oxygen intake?
mechanism_or_method: Asymmetric radiation control combined with condensation-evaporation recovers heat and moisture from exhaled air.
limitation: Tested in cold chamber; wearer comfort and long-term use not reported.

object: multi-fold twin networks in FeCoNiCuZn multi-principal element alloy
problem: How are 3D multi-fold twin architectures formed despite angular misfit in large crystals?
mechanism_or_method: Composition inhomogeneity varies twin fault energy; geometrically necessary amorphous zones at twin junctions accommodate misfit, seen by in-situ TEM and atomic electron tomography.
limitation: Nanoscale observation in specific alloys; effect on bulk properties not shown.

object: microscopy video data of active soft materials
problem: How to screen and analyze high-throughput video data from active, non-equilibrium materials?
mechanism_or_method: BARCODE open-access software compresses videos into multiparametric performance fingerprints via three material-agnostic analysis branches.
limitation: Validated on cytoskeleton and cell monolayer videos, which require wet-lab data generation.

object: wildfire multi-ignition complexes
problem: Do merged multi-ignition fire complexes drive extreme fire years and impacts?
mechanism_or_method: Analysis of 12-hourly satellite fire tracking data 2012-2023 comparing multi-ignition and single-ignition fires across ecoregions.
limitation: Only 12 years of satellite data; merge detection depends on tracking algorithm.
decision_relevance: Fire prediction and suppression resource allocation should account for fire merging.

object: growable soft humanoid robot with bone-mimetic linkages
problem: Can a humanoid robot be extensible, light, stiff and compliant for versatile mobility?
mechanism_or_method: Bone-inspired growable linkages up to 315 percent extensible, combined with servomotors in a soft humanoid for crawling, swimming, walking on water and flying.
limitation: Single 4.5 kg prototype; endurance, payload and control robustness not detailed.

object: topological mechanical metamaterial lattices of brittle material
problem: Can topological floppy modes guide cracks unidirectionally and make fracture ductile?
mechanism_or_method: Polarized floppy modes produce strongly asymmetric stress fields at crack tips, giving one-way ductile fracturing protected by bulk topology.
limitation: Lattice-scale demonstrations; behavior in real structural materials with defects not established.
decision_relevance: Lattice design for predictable crack paths in brittle structures.

object: fungal ice-nucleating proteins in Mortierellaceae
problem: Do fungi have ice-nucleating proteins and how are they related to bacterial InaZ proteins?
mechanism_or_method: Structural modeling, phylogenetics and heterologous expression show fungal INpros are InaZ orthologs likely acquired by horizontal gene transfer.
limitation: Structures are predicted, not experimentally resolved; ice-binding mechanism inferred by analogy.

object: triboelectric and electrostatic generator power management
problem: How to extract and deliver continuous, stable power from triboelectric and electrostatic generators to practical electronics?
mechanism_or_method: Self-powered peak-detection switch, voltage elevation for AC-DC conversion, and an energy regulation module allocating harvested energy.
limitation: Demonstrated with one electret generator and LoRa node at low speed; other generators untested.

object: acoustic subwavelength imaging with random scatterers
problem: Can ultrasound reach subwavelength resolution without precisely controlled or tracked labels?
mechanism_or_method: Randomly distributed deep-subwavelength scatterers act as blind labels; reconstruction does not need their locations or trajectories.
limitation: Needs scatterers delivered near target; demonstrated in controlled ultrasound experiments only.

object: nonradiative photothermal and photoacoustic wave propagation
problem: How to map generation and propagation of photoacoustic and photothermal waves at optical resolution?
mechanism_or_method: Spatial-offset pump-probe imaging offsets pump and probe beams for nanosecond, micrometer-resolution wave imaging with 9.9 Pa sensitivity.
limitation: Specialized optical setup; demonstrated on fiber emitter, tissue slices and one zebrafish larva.

object: biphasic column for organic solvent membrane extraction
problem: How to get both high selectivity and high productivity in organic solvent nanofiltration?
mechanism_or_method: Packed water droplets coated with ion-ligand complexes act as size-exclusive membranes; solute and solvent follow separate pathways.
limitation: Shown for one complex and solvent system; stability and scale-up not described.

object: submillimeter ferromagnetic soft continuum robots
problem: Can tiny magnetic continuums divide and re-merge in situ to gain reconfigurability for biomedical tasks?
mechanism_or_method: Ferromagnetic thermoplastic materials with reversible elastomer-fluid transition enable self-division and self-mergence, called regrafting.
limitation: Ex vivo or phantom-level demonstrations implied; in vivo safety and thermal effects not shown.

object: episodic landslide movements and the Preonzo landslide
problem: What drives episodic landslide movements and do they signal approach to catastrophic failure?
mechanism_or_method: Endo-exo theory of exogenous stressors and endogenous damage-healing predicts four dynamical classes with power-law exponents set by one parameter.
limitation: Tested on one landslide; precursory signal generality unproven.
decision_relevance: Early-warning criteria for landslide collapse based on velocity statistics.

object: magnesium reinforced with NbC nanoparticles via nanocolloid solidification
problem: How to disperse nanoparticles uniformly in magnesium to get ultrahigh strength without thermomechanical processing?
mechanism_or_method: Spontaneous wetting of NbC by molten Mg forms Mg-coated particles, giving stable nanocolloid and coherent hard dispersoids after solidification.
limitation: Ductility and corrosion not reported in abstract; scalability claimed but not quantified.
decision_relevance: Processing route choice for lightweight ultrahigh-strength magnesium components.

object: multi-agent flocking with heterogeneous agents
problem: Does optimally assigned inter-agent heterogeneity improve flocking stability and convergence?
mechanism_or_method: Optimization of heterogeneous agent parameters in flocking dynamics, evaluated on tracking, formation and obstacle tasks, including delays.
limitation: Simulation-based; no physical drone validation reported.
decision_relevance: Assign heterogeneous gains in swarm controllers for faster convergence.

object: reconfigurable modular origami for 2D symmetry groups
problem: Can one origami system be tuned among all 17 plane symmetry groups without refabrication?
mechanism_or_method: Single-DOF modules with kinematic bifurcation, tessellated and switched by binary air-pouch pressurization; tied to metasurface multipole selection rules.
limitation: Centimetre-scale prototypes with pneumatic actuation; scaling to optical frequencies not shown.

object: voxelated thermo-viscoelastic digital materials from jetted polymers
problem: How to inverse-design stochastically mixed multi-material voxel structures with tailored viscoelastic behavior?
mechanism_or_method: Extended percolation-theory material model over frequency and temperature, with a neural network estimating mixing for target behavior.
limitation: Limited to two constituent polymers; validated on two case studies.
decision_relevance: Material mixing selection for printed orthoses and dampers.

object: hydrogen-bond nanoconfined self-destructive polymers
problem: How to combine high mechanical strength with humidity-triggered reversible solid-to-fluid switching?
mechanism_or_method: Large ordered hydrogen-bond clusters, reduced chain entanglement and hydrophilic groups let moisture drive solid-fluid transition; heating reverses it.
limitation: Lab samples; long-term cyclic reversibility and applications under real humidity not shown.
